scenes.title: At the Iron Gate
scenes.summary: Mio brings tea to the courtyard table as Haruto uses her three simple sentences to break the ice with Daiki.

scenes.title: The Wooden Train
scenes.summary: Haruto hands Daiki their grandfather's carved wooden train just as childhood piano teacher Kazuko steps over to greet them.

scenes.title: Thirty Days on Paper
scenes.summary: Behind the front desk Takashi laments the sale notice while Kenji and Mio urge him not to give up without reading the fine print.

scenes.title: Lemon Cake and Sharp Eyes
scenes.summary: Enjoying Yuka's warm lemon cake, Daiki notices the worried faces inside the lobby window and offers help.

scenes.title: Page Two, Clause Fourteen
scenes.summary: Examining page two of the letter, Haruto points out Heritage Clause 14 protecting historic buildings with public ground-floor cafés.

scenes.title: Permanent Keys
scenes.summary: Beaming with relief, Takashi greenlights Yuka's morning courtyard café and offers Mio the permanent front-desk job.

scenes.title: Under the Golden Lanterns
scenes.summary: As evening lanterns glow across the courtyard, Mio, Kazuko, and Daiki toast the week's unexpected friendships.

scenes.title: Room Nine
scenes.summary: Fetching spare café chairs from the cellar, Kenji uncovers a locked wooden crate stamped 'Room 9' and a ninth brass key.
